description: List current EA flood warnings and alerts to check active warnings for an area. Filter by county and max_severity (1 most severe, 4 no longer in force); default 3 includes alerts. Not a site-specific risk assessment. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

county.description: Optional county name to filter EA flood warnings.

max_severity.description: Include warnings through this severity: 1 severe, 2 warning, 3 alert, 4 no longer in force; default 3.

name: flood_list_warnings
